decision_order: Check legal, security, and administrative holds.
Check the applicable retention clock and TTL.
If expired with no hold or dependency, mark eligible for review; do not automatically delete.
Record reviewer, decision, timestamp, and evidence before any separately authorized deletion.

safety_constraints: This plan is declarative and dry-run only.
No S3 object deletion is executed.
No local file deletion is executed.
Missing or uncertain timestamps must be treated as unknown, not as expired.
Holds and active dependencies override TTL expiry.
